parameter Idle=10'b0000000001, B3=10'b0000000010, S=10'b0000000100, 
              S1=10'b0000001000, Count=10'b0000010000, Wait=10'b0000100000, Done=10'b0001000000;
              
    assign shift_ena = state[Idle] | state[B3] | state[Count] | state[Wait]; // Enable shifting only in Idle, B3, Count, Wait States
    assign B3_next = state[B3]&(d|(state[S]&~d))|(state[S]&state[S1]&~d); // depends upon d and present state
    assign S_next = state[B3]; // Go to S whenever in B3
    assign S1_next =~d&state[S]&~state[S1]; // Go to S1 whenever ~d and in S and not in S1
    assign Count_next = state[Count]&(~done_counting | ack); // Go to Count whenever in Count and done_counting is low or ack is received
    assign Wait_next = state[Wait]&(~ack); // Go Wait whenever in Wait and ack is low
    assign done = state[Done]; // Assert done whenever in Done state
    assign counting = state[Count]; // Assert counting whenever in Count state
    
              
endmodule

parameter WARNING_TIME = 5; // shut off in 5 seconds
	parameter DANGER_TIME = 10; // shut off in 10 seconds
	
    always @(*) begin
        // shut off the computer
        if (cpu_overheated || arrived || gas_tank_empty) begin
            keep_driving = 0;
            if (cpu_overheated) 
                shut_off_computer = WARNING_TIME[4:0]; // show 5 seconds shut off indication
            else if (arrived || gas_tank_empty) 
                shut_off_computer = DANGER_TIME[4:0]; // show 10 seconds shut off indication
            else 
                shut_off_computer = shut_off_computer; // maintain the shut off indication
        end
        else begin
            keep_driving = 1;
            shut_off_computer = shut_off_computer; // maintain the shut off indication
        end
    end
    

endmodule

        if(areset)begin
            state = IDLE;
        end
        else begin
            case(state)
                IDLE:begin
                    if(train_valid)begin
                        state = WAIT;
                    end
                end

                    if(train_valid==0&&train_taken==1)begin
                        state = ARRVING;

                end

                    state = TRANSIT;
                end

                end

            endcase
        //$stroe means dumpvars     
        end
    end
